name: BroUseAI

sources.title: BroUseAI Submit AI form with Basic ($0) and Premium ($29) plans

conditions: Free 'Basic' plan ($0) exists but joins a waiting queue with no stated review time
On the Basic plan, updating the AI page later costs $19 per update
Paid Premium ($29 one-time + VAT, via Dodo Payments license key) skips the queue with listing within 48 hours, free forever updates, a checkmark badge, and 30-day featured eligibility
requirements: Submission is for AI tools only (form is 'Submit AI')

Strict content policy: no explicit sexual content/nudity, NSFW or offensive material, gambling/betting, extreme violence or gore, discriminatory content or hate speech, illegal activities or substance abuse, or harmful misinformation
Violating applications are rejected immediately and content can be removed even after listing
A captcha-style 'Let us know you're human' check is part of the form
preparation: Optional FAQ entries — can be left empty and BroUseAI will generate them with AI
License key field is on the form — leave empty for Basic, or paste the Dodo Payments key after buying Premium
workflow: Go to https://www.brouseai.com/submission/ai (linked as 'Submit' / 'Submit Your AI Free' from the homepage)
Choose 'Submit AI' on the submission-type selector
Enter email, AI name, URL, tagline, and pricing
Fill the overview, core features, and use cases fields; optionally add FAQs
Choose a plan: Basic $0 (queue) or Premium $29 one-time + VAT (48-hour listing, dofollow link, free updates, checkmark, featured eligibility)
If Premium, buy a license key via the Dodo Payments checkout link and paste it into the License Key field
Complete the human verification and click 'Submit AI'
Basic: wait in the queue; Premium: expect listing within 48 hours; accept/reject is sent by email
watchFor: Premium is presented as 'RECOMMENDED' with a struck-through $59 price ($29 + VAT) — the free Basic plan is easy to miss below it
The License Key field appears on the form regardless of plan; it is only needed for Premium
Free-plan listings charge $19 for any later page update — get the copy right the first time
FAQ field can be left blank; the site will AI-generate FAQs, which may not match your positioning
Acceptance/rejection notification is by email only
countsAsLive: The tool has a public page at brouseai.com/ai/<slug> and appears in the New AIs or category listings
unknowns: Length of the free Basic queue
Whether the Basic-plan link is dofollow (Premium is explicitly promised a dofollow link; Basic is only promised 'a valuable dofollow link' too, but unverified in practice)
Whether the AI name field requires a logo upload or it is auto-fetched
